args.text:
MEMO — Q1 2026 Board Deck vs. GL: US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200)
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Entity: Halvard Systems Inc. (US)
Scope: Investigation only — no journal entries posted, per request.

1. THE DECK NUMBER
DOC-0207 "Q1 2026 board deck – Appendix B: US operating expense detail" reports:
  Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026 = USD 11,769.00
The deck states it was "prepared by FP&A from the general ledger as of 2026-04-01 09:00." That snapshot timestamp is the key to the whole difference.

2. THE GL TODAY
GL 6200 (US) has no opening balance at 2026-01-01; cumulative ending balance at 2026-03-31 equals Q1 activity:
  Jan-2026:  4,289.70
  Feb-2026:  4,139.80
  Mar-2026:  6,139.50
  Q1 total: USD 14,569.00  (ties exactly to the 19 posted JEs in the account)

3. RECONCILIATION OF THE DIFFERENCE
  GL today                          14,569.00
  Board deck                        11,769.00
  Difference                         2,800.00

The difference is 100% explained by a single item — no rounding, no scope difference, no misclassification:

  JE-00304 — "Tessellate BI – TB-Q1-TRUEUP – Q1 seat true-up"
  Dr 6200 Software Subscriptions 2,800.00 / Cr 2000 Accounts Payable 2,800.00
  Entry date: 2026-03-31 (period 2026-03)
  Created/posted: 2026-04-02 10:14 by ap.clerk
  Support: DOC-0206, Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP dated 2026-03-31, "Q1 2026 seat true-up (14 additional seats, Jan–Mar)," USD 2,800.00

Conclusion: the entry was posted on 2026-04-02, i.e. roughly 25 hours AFTER the 2026-04-01 09:00 GL snapshot FP&A used. The deck is not wrong in arithmetic — it is simply stale. The GL is correct and the accounting treatment is correct: the true-up covers Jan–Mar seats, so Q1 is the proper period, and booking it at 2026-03-31 is the right cutoff. No correction to the ledger is required.

4. ITEMS RULED OUT (tested and cleared)
a) Apparent duplicate Zoom charge. JE-00247 and JE-00248 are both dated 2026-03-08 for USD 149.90 each, same memo, same card (****4417), supported by two near-identical receipts (DOC-0174 and DOC-0173). I checked the bank rather than assuming: the March statement shows TWO distinct Zoom debits on 2026-03-08 (BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063, each -149.90). Both entries are legitimate; this is NOT a duplicate and should not be reversed.
b) Misclassification / off-account software spend. The Figtree annual license (DOC-0024, USD 15,000) was correctly capitalized to 1210 Prepaid Software via JE-00029, not expensed to 6200. No US software spend was found sitting in 5200 or other accounts.
c) Period/opening-balance issues. GL 6200 opens at zero; cumulative balance equals Q1 activity, so no prior-year contamination.

5. THE CORRECT Q1 FIGURE — AND ONE CAVEAT THE DECK SHOULD REFLECT
Based on what is posted today, the correct Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions figure is USD 14,569.00, and the deck should be updated from 11,769.00.

However, flagging this before the deck is refreshed: the March close is not finished, and one remaining March entry will land in this same account.
  - Checklist item "Amortize prepaid software" (US, 2026-03) is still OPEN.
  - Schedule DOC-0067 requires monthly amortization of the Figtree license of USD 1,250.00 (Dr 6200 / Cr 1210); it notes "Jan-2026: booked, Feb-2026: booked, Mar-2026: to be booked at March close."
  - Confirmed not yet booked: GL 1210 shows March period activity of 0.00 and an ending balance of 12,500.00 (= 15,000 less only two months of amortization). Jan (JE-00108) and Feb (JE-00204) are posted; there is no March equivalent.

Therefore:
  GL 6200 as posted today                      14,569.00
  Add: March Figtree amortization still to book  1,250.00
  Expected final Q1 2026 figure            USD 15,819.00

RECOMMENDATION: Do not refresh the board deck to 14,569.00 — that would only replace one stale number with another. Wait for the March prepaid software amortization to be posted, then report Q1 US Software Subscriptions as USD 15,819.00. I have not posted that entry, as this engagement was investigation-only; it sits with the open "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item and is fully supported by DOC-0067 whenever you want it booked.

PROCESS NOTE: The root cause is that FP&A pulled the GL on 04-01 while AP was still processing 03-31-dated invoices and the close checklist was open. Recommend FP&A source board figures from a post-close-sign-off snapshot rather than a mid-close pull.

No journal entries were posted and no exceptions were logged — every difference identified is explained and supported.
